faq_heading: Homes near Earl Marriott Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Earl Marriott Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Earl Marriott Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Earl Marriott Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Earl Marriott Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 817 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,486,000, townhomes $799,000, condos $532,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Earl Marriott Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Earl Marriott Secondary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 817 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Earl Marriott Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peace Arch Elementary (0.7 km south), South Meridian Elementary (1.1 km south-east) and Jessie Lee Elementary (1.2 km north-west).

Earl Marriott Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15751 16 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: Secondary French Immersion.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Earl Marriott Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Earl Marriott Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Earl Marriott Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Earl Marriott Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 817 homes sold within 2 km of Earl Marriott Secondary: 174 houses, 169 townhomes and 404 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $532,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Earl Marriott Secondary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Earl Marriott Secondary in a straight line (8 elementary, 3 other, 2 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is Peace Arch Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sunnyside Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is St John Paul II Academy (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Newbridge Academy (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: St John Paul II Academy (1.4 km south-west), Semiahmoo Secondary (2.1 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is St John Paul II Academy, 1.4 km south-west of Earl Marriott Secondary.
